_comment: Escape hatch for per-project UI overrides. Live URL is normally discovered from each nested repo's GitHub 'homepage' field (set via repo settings → About → Website). Use this file for: (a) URLs that don't fit the default pattern, (b) projects with no index.html (override previewUrl to the real entry point), (c) marking projects as dropped/archived, (d) hiding projects from the gallery entirely. Fields: liveUrl, previewUrl, description, status ('dropped' | 'archived' | 'draft' | 'active'), skip (true to exclude from gallery). Also: subcategory (gallery section), cadence ('15min' | 'hourly' | '6h' | 'daily' | 'weekly' | 'monthly' — how often the project refreshes itself on a schedule; puts it in the gallery's 'Updating on their own' panel).
